name: Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser
description: The Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser, also known simply as the Interdictor-class heavy cruiser, Interdictor-class medium frigate, Interdictor Dreadnaught, or simply the Interdictor, and sometimes colloqually as the Drag Ship, was a 600-meter-long cruiser built on the standard Vindicator-class heavy cruiser hull (later used for the Enforcer-class picket cruiser).

data.name: Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser
